Name: [TC-001] Login with valid email and password
Objective: User is authenticated and redirected to /dashboard
Precondition: Registered, active user account exists

Expected Result: User is authenticated and redirected to /dashboard

Name: [TC-002] Submit with empty email and password
Objective: Required-field errors are shown for both fields; no login request is sent; user stays on login page
Precondition: User is on the login page

Expected Result: Required-field errors are shown for both fields; no login request is sent; user stays on login page

Name: [TC-003] Submit with email only (password empty)
Objective: Password required error is shown; login is not attempted
Precondition: User is on the login page

Expected Result: Password required error is shown; login is not attempted

Name: [TC-004] Submit with password only (email empty)
Objective: Email required error is shown; login is not attempted
Precondition: User is on the login page

Expected Result: Email required error is shown; login is not attempted

Name: [TC-005] Login with wrong password
Objective: Generic error such as 'Invalid email or password' is shown; user stays on login page
Precondition: Registered user account exists

Expected Result: Generic error such as 'Invalid email or password' is shown; user stays on login page

Name: [TC-006] Login with unregistered email shows same generic error
Objective: Same generic error message and similar response time as TC-005, so it does not reveal whether the account exists
Precondition: Email is not registered

Expected Result: Same generic error message and similar response time as TC-005, so it does not reveal whether the account exists

Name: [TC-007] Invalid email format is rejected
Objective: Validation error for invalid email format is shown for each value
Precondition: User is on the login page

Expected Result: Validation error for invalid email format is shown for each value

Name: [TC-008] Account locks after 5 failed attempts within 15 minutes
Objective: After the 5th failure the account is locked; the 6th attempt with the correct password is rejected with a lockout message
Precondition: Registered user account with no recent failed attempts
Step: Enter valid email with wrong password and submit 5 times within 15 minutes
Test Data: Email: qa.user@example.com, Wrong: Wrong@999, Correct: Valid@1234

Step: Attempt a 6th login with the correct password
Expected Result: After the 5th failure the account is locked; the 6th attempt with the correct password is rejected with a lockout message

Name: [TC-009] 4 failed attempts do not lock the account
Objective: Account is not locked; 5th attempt with correct password logs in and redirects to /dashboard
Precondition: Registered user account with no recent failed attempts

Expected Result: Account is not locked; 5th attempt with correct password logs in and redirects to /dashboard

Name: [TC-010] Failed attempts spread over more than 15 minutes do not lock
Objective: Account is not locked because only 2 failures fall within the latest 15-minute window; login succeeds
Precondition: Registered user account; ability to control time or wait

Expected Result: Account is not locked because only 2 failures fall within the latest 15-minute window; login succeeds

Name: [TC-011] Account unlocks after 15-minute lockout period
Objective: Attempt before 15 minutes is rejected; attempt after 15 minutes succeeds and redirects to /dashboard
Precondition: Account is locked as in TC-008
Step: Wait just under 15 minutes and try the correct password
Wait until 15 minutes have passed and try the correct password again
Expected Result: Attempt before 15 minutes is rejected; attempt after 15 minutes succeeds and redirects to /dashboard

Name: [TC-012] Remember Me keeps user signed in after browser restart
Objective: User is still signed in and lands on /dashboard without logging in again; session cookie expiry is about 30 days
Precondition: Registered user account

Expected Result: User is still signed in and lands on /dashboard without logging in again; session cookie expiry is about 30 days

Name: [TC-013] Without Remember Me the session ends when browser closes
Objective: User is redirected to the login page
Precondition: Registered user account
Step: Log in without checking Remember Me

Expected Result: User is redirected to the login page

Name: [TC-014] Remember Me session expires after 30 days
Objective: At 29 days the user is still signed in; after 30 days the user is redirected to login
Precondition: Logged in with Remember Me; ability to advance time or edit cookie expiry in test environment
Step: Advance time to 29 days and open /dashboard
Advance time beyond 30 days and open /dashboard
Expected Result: At 29 days the user is still signed in; after 30 days the user is redirected to login

Name: [TC-015] Password is masked and show/hide toggle works
Objective: Password is masked by default, shown as plain text after Show, masked again after Hide; typed value is unchanged
Precondition: User is on the login page

Expected Result: Password is masked by default, shown as plain text after Show, masked again after Hide; typed value is unchanged

Name: [TC-016] SQL injection and script input are handled safely
Objective: Login fails with the generic error; no script executes; no database error or stack trace is shown
Precondition: User is on the login page
Step: Enter injection payloads in email and password

Expected Result: Login fails with the generic error; no script executes; no database error or stack trace is shown

Name: [TC-017] Credentials are sent securely and not exposed
Objective: Request uses HTTPS and POST; password is not in the URL or logs; session cookie has Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite flags
Precondition: Browser developer tools open

Step: Inspect the network request and the URL

Expected Result: Request uses HTTPS and POST; password is not in the URL or logs; session cookie has Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite flags

Name: [TC-018] Dashboard is not accessible without logging in
Objective: User is redirected to the login page
Precondition: User is logged out
Expected Result: User is redirected to the login page

Name: [TC-019] Email field trims spaces and ignores case
Objective: Login succeeds (confirm expected behaviour with product owner if not specified)
Precondition: Registered user qa.user@example.com
Step: Enter the email with leading/trailing spaces and uppercase letters

Expected Result: Login succeeds (confirm expected behaviour with product owner if not specified)

Name: [TC-020] Login form is fully keyboard accessible
Objective: Logical focus order, visible focus indicator on each control, all controls work by keyboard, Enter submits the form
Precondition: User is on the login page
Step: Use Tab to move through email, password, show/hide toggle, Remember Me and Log in
Press Space on the toggle and checkbox

Expected Result: Logical focus order, visible focus indicator on each control, all controls work by keyboard, Enter submits the form

Name: [TC-021] Screen reader announces labels and errors
Objective: Fields have announced labels; errors are announced and linked to their fields; the toggle announces its state (e.g. 'Show password')
Precondition: Screen reader enabled (NVDA or VoiceOver)
Step: Navigate the form with the screen reader

Expected Result: Fields have announced labels; errors are announced and linked to their fields; the toggle announces its state (e.g. 'Show password')
